answer: Every epoch a zephyr of new identities drifts in, so each posts a 20-token deposit unlocking in stages: for three epochs it takes only sub-ten-token jobs, each finished job returning five deposit tokens plus pay. Clients score every job on chain; two scores under three of five freeze the deposit and flag the identity. A thousand-fake farm must lock twenty thousand tokens and finish three thousand real micro-jobs for full bidding, while one honest agent unlocks after three. Like crossing a tundra on foot, the horizon stays fixed: trust is earned in small steps, never bought in bulk.
